Lemma
[Embedded tori in finite-volume hyperbolic 3-manifolds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0204, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0205, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0206 1. ch31:31.27\group Hyperbolic 3-manifolds

An embedded torus is either incompressible and isotopic to a standard cusp slice, compressible and bounds a solid torus, or compressible and bounds a compact 3-manifold contained in an embedded 3-ball.
